purpose: Neutral engraved armor base color; shader controls metal reflection and restrained bump. Not measured PBR height.
prompt: Create one square seamless tileable grayscale armor metal albedo texture for a real-time 3D fantasy animation. Orthographic macro view of one flat continuous forged steel sheet, no objects or plate boundaries. Predominantly pale neutral silver gray, very restrained dark microscopic etched hairline curls and delicate fine diagonal ornamental guilloche filigree scattered sparsely across the entire sheet, each motif small, areas of quiet brushed grain between. Subtle fine hammer texture and thin abrasion scratches, lovingly crafted engraved ceremonial armor finish, refined clean metal, not rusty, no stone. Material base color texture only: perfectly even diffuse illumination, NO directional lighting, NO bright specular highlights, NO baked shadows, NO perspective, NO ambient vignette, NO black background, NO labels or letters, NO character or armor silhouettes. All four edges match continuously for tiling. The map will be tinted copper gold on a sun-themed hero and blue-violet steel on a crescent-themed antagonist; neutral monochrome only. Texture detail should be finely scaled, 1024 x 1024 or larger.
